mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Toss_t(id, orderId, orderName, amount, approvedAt, payCount, statusCount, payStatus, cancelReason, canceledAt, paymentKey) VALUES(#{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderName}, #{amount}, #{approvedAt}, #{payCount}, #{payCount}, #{payStatus}, #{cancelReason}, #{canceledAt}, #{paymentKey})
mapper.update: update User_t set payCount = payCount + #{payCount} where id=#{id}
update User_t set payCount = payCount - #{payCount} where id=#{id}
